config.subscribeText: Like it? Make it yours. Send your real week — what happened, what you do now, what you plan — to i.kartuzov@gmail.com and get up to 8 new sentences built into your app. No subscription: pay only when you want a fresh pack. One top-up €5 (normally €6).

cloze.rule: fiz = I made/did (pretérito perfeito — a finished action). faço = I do (present). fazia = I used to do (imperfeito). 'Ontem' (yesterday) is finished → fiz.
gostar always takes de. Before 'o meu' it contracts: de + o = do. So: gosto do meu gato.
estar a + infinitive = happening right now (European Portuguese). 'está a ficar' = is getting. (In Brazil: 'está ficando'.)
há + a length of time = 'for'. 'há dois anos' = for two years. desde = since a point in time.
To ask someone's name (polite): 'Como se chama?'. The verb 'chamar' carries the pronoun 'se' here.
Comecei = I started (perfeito — one finished event). Começo = I start (present). You started lessons → comecei.
ir + infinitive = the near future: 'vou visitar' = I'm going to visit. After 'vou' use the infinitive.
To say your own name: 'Chamo-me …' = my name is …. ('chamar' + 'me' for 'I').
fiz = cooked (past, completed action). «Ontem» (yesterday) → the action is finished.
